tastingDescription:
91 pts, Decanter.
"Super ripe and perfumed on the nose. Bright, almost searing on the palate then chalky with a crystalline mineral edged finish. Clean and precise, lacks a touch more density on the mid palate, but this is well worked with balance and a long salty finish. Cool blue fruits are lovely as are the licks of menthol, eucalyptus and flint." Drink 2025 - 2039
name: ST ESTEPHE - CHATEAU LAFON ROCHET 2021

tastingDescription:
95 pts, Georgina Hindle, Decanter.
"Silky smooth with excellent freshness, firm fleshy tannins and a minty, liquorice-tinged freshness throughout. Tannins are fine and supportive and give this a broad mouthfeel while keeping direction and forward motion. Sophisticated with plenty of layers of flavour while keeping a classic touch despite the tough vintage conditions. Still a little shy, give this a few years, but great potential for future enjoyment. Strength and succulence. Brilliant."
name: ST ESTEPHE - CHATEAU LAFON ROCHET 2022

tastingDescription:
"A terrific Saint-Estephe, the 2020 Chateau Le Boscq reveals a deep ruby/purple hue to go with classic aromatics of cassis, ripe black cherries, smoked tobacco, and damp earth. This medium to full-bodied, pure, nicely concentrated 2020 has the structure and purity to evolve for two decades in cold cellars. Best After 2023." 
93 pts, Jeb Dunnuck
name: ST ESTEPHE - CHATEAU LE BOSCQ 2020

tastingDescription:
92 pts, Wine Enthusiast.
"This 44-acre estate is dominated by its rich Merlot. This new release is dense and solid with tannins that will need time. It is a full, ripe, finely chiseled wine that should be ready from 2027."
name: ST ESTEPHE - CHATEAU LE BOSCQ 2021

sort: ST ESTEPHE - CHATEAU LES ORMES DE PEZ 2000
tastingDescription: 91 Points, James Suckling: "So youthful now with lots of thick spicy fruit. Still tight but loads going on. Thick and powerful. A little four square. But there. Serious." (June 2016)
name: ST ESTEPHE - CHATEAU LES ORMES DE PEZ 2000
nameSanitized: st estephe - chateau les ormes de pez 2000

sort: ST ESTEPHE - CHATEAU LES ORMES DE PEZ 2021
tastingDescription:
91 pts, Decanter.
"Sweet strawberry, orange, grapefruit, plums and blackcurrants, but the sweet jammy kind. This is fruit forward and expressive out the gate, round and so appealing. Spiced aspects from the Petit Verdot with a sturdy backbone in terms of structure and frame. Tannins are more on the austere side, fine and detailed, extremely mouthfilling but you can almost taste each one with the minerality coming through strongly leaving that clean wet stone taste in the mouth. Ripe and juicy dark fruit also. This is medium bodied with lots of precision in terms of detail. Lovely potential here. 5% Petit Verdot completes the blend." Drink 2024 - 2040
name: ST ESTEPHE - CHATEAU LES ORMES DE PEZ 2021
nameSanitized: st estephe - chateau les ormes de pez 2021

sort: ST ESTEPHE - CHATEAU LES ORMES DE PEZ 2022
tastingDescription:
94 pts, James Molesworth, Wine Spectator.
"This is stylish in the way it captures the warm cassis and mulled plum fruit of the vintage, along with the AOC's telltale warm stone, lilac and iron accents. The long, smoldering finish pulls everything together thanks to a subtle chalky thread. Understated and nicely done. Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot. name: WILD GOOSE - AUTUMN GOLD 2025

tastingDescription: An intense and aromatic Gewürztraminer with classic rose petals and lychee notes mingling with peach, papaya and citrus on the nose. The complementary sweetness on the palate is balanced by fresh acidity, which provides the framework for the lychee, pineapple, ginger and citrus zest to last through the long finish.
name: WILD GOOSE - GEWURZTRAMINER 2024

tastingDescription: An aromatic and intense wine with aromas of rose water, white peach, papaya, cantaloupe, mandarin orange and lemongrass. The palate is just off-dry, full-bodied with a rich texture and balanced by fresh acidity. Turkish Delight, lime, pear, pineapple, cinnamon and ginger linger through a long finish."
name: WILD GOOSE - GEWURZTRAMINER 2025

tastingDescription: An Okanagan Falls grape growing pioneer in the early 1980s, the winery followed in 1990 with much success. The Pinot Gris sources from estate and up-the-valley fruit and is always a flavourful glass of this varietal. Look for typical Okanagan tree fruit flavours, a juiciness and lip-smacking persistence. It will go all kinds of menu, from salmon to pasta to grilled fare.
name: WILD GOOSE - PINOT GRIS 2025

tastingDescription: Zesty, intense drier style Riesling. Nose shows bright lime zest, green apple and pear, fresh green herbs, nectarine, honey and flint. The off-dry palate is balanced with high racy mineral acidity with more grapefruit, lemon and lime citrus notes joined by peach and a long finish of wet stone minerality.
name: WILD GOOSE - RIESLING STONEY SLOPE 2022

tastingDescription: A lovely combination showing classic Sauvignon Blanc aroma traits of lemongrass and herbal freshness along with tropical passionfruit, gooseberry, grapefruit and floral blossom notes. The palate is dry, crisp, racy and fresh with lemon, lime, pear skin, green apple and some chalky mineral notes through the long finish.
name: WILD GOOSE-SAUVIGNON BLANC

tastingDescription: For over 130 years, Bodegas Williams & Humbert have been producing the finest sherries and brandies. Dry Sack is a distinctive blend of Palomino and Pedro Ximenez grapes aged in oak casks for six years in the traditional solera method. Nose: Intense aromas of dried nuts. Palate: Full-bodied and balanced. Lightly sweet, not too dry nor too sweet.
name: WILLIAMS AND HUMBERT - DRY SACK

sort: WINEMAKER'S CUT - Q AND A MRV 2021
tastingDescription: The inaugural vintage of the Q&A White offers a generous nose of honeyed apricots, candied lemon, and beeswax, lifted by expressive orange blossom aromatics and delicate oak spice. Textured, intensely concentrated, and beautifully balanced, it will effortlessly cellar for three to five years. (92 points - The Global and Mail)
name: WINEMAKER'S CUT - Q AND A MRV 2021
nameSanitized: winemakers cut - q and a mrv 2021

tastingDescription: A bright lemon colour with a fresh-picked fruit aroma of peach, nectarine, and lemon. This light-bodied wine has a clean, pure fruit expression, and a splash of refreshment. Tree-fruit flavours of apple, pear, yellow plum and a touch of citrus dance on the palate and linger through on the finish.
name: XOXO - PINOT GRIGIO LIGHT

tastingDescription: Off-dry and medium-bodied, with notes of bright red fruit along with vanilla and a slight hint of cloves.
name: XOXO - PINOT NOIR

tastingDescription: A delicate copper pink colour with aromas of ripe strawberry, white grape, watermelon and sweet floral. This rose has a medium-sweet, light to medium body mouth-feel and refreshing flavours of watermelon, strawberry and grape. Notes of red berry tea, strawberry, melon and honey linger on the finish.
name: XOXO - ROSE

tastingDescription: Bubbles pops with citrus flavours and a fresh, creamy finish. Flavours of tropical fruits combine perfectly with medium sweetness and a delightfully crisp finish. The everyday celebration!
name: YELLOW TAIL - BUBBLES

tastingDescription: Pink Bubbles is sparkling, bubbly goodness ready to brighten up ordinary moments, everyday. Made from blending red and white wines, this bubbly has a pink hue and an appealing bouquet of wild strawberry, red cherry and sweet spice. Red grape flavours predominate with red cherry, sweet spice and tropical fruits at the forefront.
name: YELLOW TAIL - PINK BUBBLES

tastingDescription: Inviting strawberry aromas, a splash of citrus bubble with refreshing fruit characters of berry and lime with a hint of lemon. A great value wine from Australia's premier house of sparkling.
name: YELLOWGLEN - PINK

sort: YOSHI NO GAWA - BREWMASTER'S CHOICE PREMIUM HONJOZO SAKE
name: YOSHI NO GAWA - BREWMASTER'S CHOICE PREMIUM HONJOZO SAKE
nameSanitized: yoshi no gawa - brewmasters choice premium honjozo sake

sort: YOSHI NO GAWA - BREWMASTER'S CHOICE PREMIUM HONJOZO SAKE
tastingDescription: Rice polished down to 65%. The name tells everything about this sake. This is the sake that sake brewmasters want to drink on regular basis themselves. Crafted using local "Gohyaku-man-goku" sake rice, this can be enjoyed chilled or heated. It is smooth with a clean finish.
name: YOSHI NO GAWA - BREWMASTER'S CHOICE PREMIUM HONJOZO SAKE
nameSanitized: yoshi no gawa - brewmasters choice premium honjozo sake

sort: YOSHI NO GAWA - GOKUJO GINJO PREMIUM SAKE
tastingDescription: Crisp aromas of fennel and fresh herbs. Ultra-smooth and refreshing with delicate elements of honeydew, orange-magnolia flowers and anise on the finish.
name: YOSHI NO GAWA - GOKUJO GINJO PREMIUM SAKE
nameSanitized: yoshi no gawa - gokujo ginjo premium sake

tastingDescription: Great entry level sake! Fruity and floral on the nose while it is drier on the palate. A smooth silky mouthfeel with a crisp and refreshing finish, yet its subtle sweetness is quite satisfying. Not only its aroma and flavour, but also its friendly price is reasonable for many consumers.
name: YUKI HOTARU - SAKE

tastingDescription: Refreshing, clean and versatile. Fragrant aromas of rice and almond. Medium-bodied, luscious mouthfeel and excellent balance. Nice flavours of sweet rice, nut and complex lingering hints of vanilla. Try in cocktails and low-alcohol refreshment beverages. Serve chilled in a wine glass or warm up.
name: YUKI HOTARU -SAKE

tastingDescription: Deep ruby colour with an expressive nose, excellent balance and complex aromatics. Plenty of ripe purple black fruits and dried red cherry followed by hints of sandalwood, herbs, and spice. The finish is dry, long, and similar to classic Syrah. An excellent wine for a BBQ feast!
name: ZENATA - THALVIN GRAILLOT SYROCCO

tastingDescription: Rich aromas of wild red fruit, complemented by delicate floral and violet notes. The palate is fresh and lively, with flavours of candied plum and Eton mess, leading to a juicy, ripe finish. This rosé pairs well with seafood paella and is ideal for summer enjoyment. A unique wine from North Africa.
name: ZENATA ROSE - THALVIN GRAILLOT TANDEM

tastingDescription: Vibrant garnet red colour. On the nose, aromas of red fruit, coffee and a hint of spice. Its tannins are reactive, with a vibrant structure and a juicy sensation. A balanced wine with an aromatic finish.
name: ZINFANDEL - MONTGRAS DE VINE RESERVA

tastingDescription: 91 Points, James Suckling: "Intense and lively purple color. The nose presents ripe red fruit such as plum and cherry and subtle herbal notes. Approachable and round tannins on the palate, balanced acidity and a fruity finish. Medium-bodied, elegant and fresh, with all the typicity of Malbec from the Uco Valley." ()
name: ZUCCARDI SERIE A MALBEC
